note: Feeds the daily news digest reads (scripts/fetch-news.ts). RSS or Atom only: a site without a feed is not scraped. Every entry was fetched and parsed on 2026-09-07. Romanian government hosts (cnadnr.ro, mt.ro, cnir.ro, metrorex.ro, gov.ro) and Bulgaria's api.bg refuse connections from outside their own country, so their news is reachable only second hand; cnair.ro is not CNAIR but a squatted domain serving a 2016 post. clubferoviar.ro and proinfrastructura.ro were dropped: both now answer any non-browser client with a JavaScript challenge. koridorisrbije.rs is an empty Angular shell, so the corridors are covered through mgsi and putevi-srbije instead. A general feed is filtered to items that name a section or use infrastructure vocabulary; a trade feed is kept whole. Wikipedia article histories are watched from the projects' own sources and need no entry here.

sources.name: Economedia
sources.note: Business daily with a regular infrastructure beat.

sources.name: Profit.ro
sources.note: Served with a text/html content type; the body is RSS 2.0.

sources.name: CFR SA
sources.note: The national rail infrastructure manager. Line closures, restorations and works notices, same day.

sources.name: Ministarstvo građevinarstva, saobraćaja i infrastrukture
sources.note: The Serbian construction and transport ministry. Cyrillic, which the matcher transliterates before scoring.

sources.name: JP Putevi Srbije
sources.note: The roads authority. A Joomla category feed, which is why the site looked feedless: the plain URL serves HTML.

sources.name: Infrastruktura železnice Srbije
sources.note: The rail infrastructure manager. Carries tender notices for the Belgrade to Niš high speed line.

sources.name: Srbija Voz
sources.note: The passenger operator. Announces which sections carry trains, which is how a Serbian line opening becomes visible.

sources.name: Metropolitan Sofia
sources.note: Sofia Metro. This host was recorded as a 404: the feed is declared in the page head at a path nothing links to.

sources.name: CINEA
sources.note: The agency that awards Connecting Europe Facility money, where a cross border project is named before it is built.

sources.name: European Investment Bank, project pipeline
sources.note: Projects the bank is appraising, named before approval. The earliest structured notice of a project this dataset does not hold.
